## 3. A cost this pipeline does NOT contain: P2's labelled FAN on the S0 tokens (the bank adapter reads `sub[N,64,6]`)

The S0 mode takes P2's fan labels as a PINNED INPUT (`fan_labels_sha256`) and refuses any token without a row. What I found (shapes and key names only): the S0 `<unit>.fan.npz` files hold P2's own fresh logits/pick but NO labels, and `<unit>.sets.npz` `labels6` belongs to the fit sets' own proposals. UNVERIFIED that a labelled fan of P2's FRESH forward exists for the 8,922 S0 tokens. If it does not, it is one more job: 8922 tokens x 64 plans; the label route costs 1.034 s/token for the metric cache plus 0.0133 s/plan, and the L2-FRESH run labelled 96 plans/token at 1.7975 s/token, so at most **4.45 h on one thread** (MEASURED rate, ESTIMATED total; CPU, no GPU).
